faqs.question: Do I need an RO water purifier?
faqs.answer: If your water TDS is above 500 ppm, or if you use borewell, tanker or hard water, an RO purifier is recommended. Our experts provide a free water quality check to help you choose the right purifier.

faqs.question: Does RO purification remove essential minerals?
faqs.answer: Modern RO systems with Mineralizer, Alkaline Filter or TDS Controller restore essential minerals like calcium and magnesium for healthier drinking water.

faqs.question: Can an RO purifier remove bacteria and viruses?
faqs.answer: Yes. Advanced RO systems with UV and UF purification effectively remove bacteria, viruses, cysts and other harmful microorganisms.

faqs.question: What maintenance does an RO water purifier require?
faqs.answer: Filter replacement, RO membrane inspection, storage tank cleaning, pump & electrical component checks and water quality testing.

faqs.question: Can one RO purifier work with borewell and municipal water?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most modern RO purifiers can treat borewell, municipal, tanker and mixed water supplies depending on the TDS level.

blog_posts.title: Benefits of AMC for RO Water Purifier Maintenance
blog_posts.excerpt: Discover the benefits of an RO purifier AMC plan, including timely service, filter checks, breakdown support, better water taste, and long-term maintenance savings.

body.lead: An RO AMC keeps purifier service planned, reduces surprise breakdowns, and helps maintain water quality through the year.

p: An AMC (Annual Maintenance Contract) lets you schedule regular service for your RO water purifier, instead of calling for help only after something breaks.
Filters and membranes need to be checked at the right intervals. With an AMC, your service schedule is tracked for you, so there are no long gaps between visits.
Regular maintenance means better taste, steadier flow and fewer unexpected issues. It also helps protect important parts such as the pump and the membrane.
A good AMC makes it clear when service is due, what was checked, and whether a part is really needed.
Aakash Aqua Tech provides professional RO service, installation, guidance and after-sales support for home and commercial customers.

blog_posts.title: Why TDS Matters in Drinking Water
blog_posts.excerpt: Learn what TDS means in drinking water, why it affects taste and purifier selection, and how RO systems help manage high TDS water at home.

body.lead: TDS helps identify dissolved impurities and choose the right RO purifier for taste, safety, and daily use.

p: TDS means total dissolved solids. The reading covers dissolved minerals, salts and other substances in your water.
It is measured in PPM and shows whether your water needs basic filtration or stronger purification.
Very high TDS can make water taste salty, bitter or heavy, while very low TDS can make it taste flat.
list: Very high TDS: salty, bitter or heavy
A good purifier improves both safety and taste

sections.h: How RO helps with high TDS
p: RO membranes are built to reduce dissolved impurities. That makes RO systems useful for borewell and tanker water, which often has higher TDS than normal.

sections.h: Do not depend only on taste
p: Water can look clear and still contain high dissolved solids. A TDS meter reading, together with what you know about your water source, helps you choose the right purifier.
Our technicians can test your water, explain the reading, and recommend a purifier or service plan based on your actual water quality.

blog_posts.title: RO vs UV vs UF Water Purifier: Which One Is Best?
blog_posts.excerpt: Understand the difference between RO, UV, and UF water purifiers and choose the right purifier based on TDS, water source, bacteria risk, and home usage.

body.lead: Choose RO for high TDS, UV for microbial safety, UF for low-TDS filtration, and combined systems for broader protection.

p: RO purification is useful when water has dissolved salts, hardness or higher TDS. Water passes through a membrane that reduces dissolved impurities and improves taste.
RO is commonly preferred for borewell, tanker and mixed-source water.
UV uses ultraviolet light to help deactivate microorganisms. It helps where microbial risk is a concern, but it does not reduce dissolved salts or hardness by itself.
UF works without electricity in many designs. It helps reduce suspended particles and some microbial impurities.
It suits low-TDS water, but it is not a replacement for RO when dissolved salts are high.
The right choice depends on your water source and TDS level.
list: Broader protection: RO + UV + UF together

blog_posts.title: 7 Signs Your RO Filter Needs Replacement
blog_posts.excerpt: Know the common signs that your RO filter needs replacement, including bad taste, slow water flow, high TDS, leakage, odor, and poor purification performance.

body.lead: Replace RO filters when taste, smell, flow, TDS, or filter life indicates reduced performance.

sections.h: Bad taste or smell in water
p: A sudden change in water taste or smell is one of the easiest signs to notice. Pre-carbon and post-carbon filters help with taste and odour, and when they wear out, water can seem dull, salty or off.

If the storage tank fills much more slowly than usual, filters may be clogged or the membrane may have pressure problems. Low inlet pressure can cause the same symptom, so a technician should check the full system.
A rising TDS level after purification can mean the membrane is losing efficiency. Taste alone is not a reliable way to judge TDS, so use a proper meter for a clear picture of purifier health.
Replace a filter when it passes its recommended service life, or when water looks cloudy before purification. Old filters strain the pump and membrane, so replacement should not be delayed.
We recommend genuine compatible filters and a water quality check after replacement. Proper installation prevents leakage, loose fittings and poor purification.

blog_posts.title: How Often Should You Service Your RO Water Purifier?
blog_posts.excerpt: Learn how often to service an RO water purifier, when to replace filters, and why regular RO maintenance keeps drinking water safe, clean, and better tasting.

body.lead: Service your home RO purifier every three to six months, and check it sooner when taste, flow, or TDS changes.

p: Your purifier runs every day to remove dissolved impurities, sediment, taste problems and contaminants. Filters, membrane, tubing and the storage tank all need timely attention.
Regular service supports taste, steady flow and safe daily performance.
A basic check every three to six months is good practice for most homes. Sediment and carbon filters may need earlier replacement with heavy dust, odour or high usage.
The membrane usually lasts longer. Assess it through TDS readings and flow performance, instead of guessing.
It is better to book service early rather than waiting until the purifier stops completely.
Our technicians check these points, so service is reliable and you avoid unnecessary part replacement.

blog_posts.excerpt: 5 Easy Ways to Improve Your Immune System Naturally People across different countries, cultures, lifestyles, and food habits may be

body.lead: A strong immune system helps your body fight illness. Stress, poor food, lack of sleep and dehydration can weaken it, but small daily habits make a big difference. Here are 5 easy ways to boost immunity naturally.

p: Sleep helps the body repair itself and supports immunity. People who sleep under 6 hours are more likely to get colds, coughs and fatigue.
Recommended sleep: adults at least 7 hours, teenagers 8–10 hours, children and infants up to 14 hours.
list: Eat dinner at least an hour before sleeping
Create a calm, comfortable sleeping space

sections.h: Stay hydrated with clean drinking water
p: Water moves nutrients, removes toxins and keeps organs working. Healthy adults should drink about 4–6 litres a day, depending on lifestyle and climate. Start the day with a glass of water and keep drinking through the day.
The water should be clean, so use a reliable purifier such as one from Aakash Water Purifier.
Vitamins, minerals, antioxidants and fibre help the body fight infection. Wash fruits and vegetables before eating to remove dirt, pesticides and germs.

sections.h: Exercise for at least 20 minutes daily
p: Regular activity strengthens immunity and improves circulation, and you do not need expensive equipment. Experts recommend about 150 minutes of moderate exercise a week, which is just 20 minutes a day.
Long-term stress weakens immunity and can lead to poor eating, smoking, drinking and lack of sleep. Even 5–10 minutes of deep breathing and relaxation daily can help.

body.closing: Clean and safe drinking water is one of the first steps toward a healthier life. Choose healthy habits today and build a stronger tomorrow.
